children: CHICAGO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mutual Federal Bancorp, Inc. ("Mutual Federal Bancorp") (OTC: "MFDB"), the mid-tier holding company for Mutual Federal Bank (the "Bank"), announced today that MFB Bancorp, Inc. ("MFB Bancorp"), a newly formed Delaware company and the proposed successor holding company of the Bank, has commenced its stock offering in connection with the proposed conversion of Mutual Federal Bancorp, MHC ("Mutual Federal, MHC") from the mutual holding company structure to the stock holding company form of organization.

MFB Bancorp is offering for sale up to 1,035,000 shares (subject to an adjustment to up to 1,190,250 shares) of common stock at a purchase price of $10.00 per share. The shares will be offered in a subscription offering to eligible depositors of the Bank as of March 31, 2025, to the Bank's tax qualified benefit plans and to other eligible members and certain borrowers of the Bank. Shares of common stock that are not subscribed for in the subscription offering may be offered for sale to members of the general public in a community offering with a preference first to natural persons residing in Cook County, Illinois and then to stockholders of Mutual Federal Bancorp as of the close of business on November 9, 2026.
MFB Bancorp's common stock is expected to be quoted on the OTC Markets Group's OTCQB Market under the symbol "MFDB" upon completion of the conversion and stock offering.

All questions concerning the conversion and stock offering or requests for stock offering materials should be directed to the Stock Information Center at (312) 521-1600. The Stock Information Center is open Monday through Friday between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Central Time, except for bank holidays.

Completion of the conversion and stock offering remains subject to final regulatory approvals, the approval of Mutual Federal Bancorp's stockholders and the members of Mutual Federal, MHC, and the sale of at least 765,000 shares of common stock at the minimum of the offering range.
Performance Trust Capital Partners, LLC is acting as marketing agent to MFB Bancorp in connection with the stock offering.

This release is neither an offer to sell nor a solicitation of an offer to buy common stock of MFB Bancorp. The offer is made only by MFB Bancorp's prospectus when accompanied by a stock order form. The shares of common stock of MFB Bancorp are not savings accounts or savings deposits, may lose value and are not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other government agency.

MFB Bancorp has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") a registration statement for the offering to which this press release relates and has filed with the SEC the final prospectus, dated November 10, 2026, for the subscription and community offerings. Before you invest, you should read that prospectus and other documents MFB Bancorp has filed with the SEC for more complete information about MFB Bancorp and the stock offering. You may obtain these documents for free by visiting EDGAR on the SEC website at

Mutual Federal Bancorp is a federally chartered mid-tier mutual holding company for Mutual Federal Bank, a community-oriented savings association operating from a single location in Chicago, Illinois. The Bank originates one-to-four-family residential real estate loans, multifamily real estate and commercial real estate loans, construction loans and home equity loans and lines of credit. Mutual Federal Bancorp's common stock is quoted on the OTCID Market under the symbol "MFDB".
